Hi! I'm Rikhitha Varma, a student at Monash University with a strong interest in data analysis, visualisation, and communicating information through meaningful stories.

I enjoy exploring real world issues through data and finding ways to make complex research easier for people to understand. I believe effective data communication is not just about presenting numbers, but also about explaining what they mean and why they matter.

::: {.about-feature-grid}

::: {.about-feature}

## <span class="feature-icon">📊</span> My Interests

My academic interests include data analytics, statistical analysis, data visualisation, and evidence based communication. I particularly enjoy using visualisations and clear explanations to make research findings accessible to a wider audience.

:::

::: {.about-feature}

## <span class="feature-icon">💻</span> My Skills

I have experience using R, Excel, and Quarto for data analysis, visualisation, and communication. I am continuing to develop my skills in data storytelling, combining analytical thinking with clear and engaging communication.

:::

:::

## About This Website

Welcome to my personal data storytelling website!

Here, I share insights from research and explore important issues through data. My blog focuses on communicating evidence in a clear, engaging, and visually informative way.

My featured article examines healthcare associated infections in Germany and explores why counting infections alone does not always reveal their true impact on public health.
